verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe on-demand deployments with dedicated GPUs isolated from other users ('predictable performance unaffected by other users', 'no hard rate limits'), autoscaling (including scale-to-zero) configuration, and benchmarking tools to validate performance — directly matching the story's dedicated-capacity + autoscaling + isolation requirements. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of autoscaling behavior under real traffic and no explicit mention of upper-bound scale-out limits or SLAs.
